articles.title: Solana Foundation hires Binance, Polygon veterans as it ramps up tokenized finance push
articles.snippet: Rachel Conlan and Jamal Raees join as Solana aims to court institutions moving payments and assets onchain.

articles.title: New York sues Polymarket over alleged illegal gambling business
articles.snippet: The action filed by state lawmakers followed a similar lawsuit against prediction markets company Kalshi in July that alleged the platform was running an illegal gambling operation.

articles.title: Trump reveals up to $100K Strategy stock purchase in ethics filing
articles.snippet: President Donald Trump disclosed a July purchase of Strategy shares as his administration continues to advance crypto policy through federal regulators and Congress.

articles.title: New York Wants to Ban Polymarket, Lawsuit Calls It 'Illegal Gambling Operation'
articles.snippet: Attorney General Letitia James and Governor Kathy Hochul allege the prediction market operates without a license and exposes New Yorkers to gambling harms.

articles.title: £10K Reward Offered After UK Couple Attacked in Crypto Home Invasion
articles.snippet: Police believe the robbery was planned and targeted, with instructions relayed to the three attackers by a fourth man on a video call.
